projects.title: Enterio: Movie & Show Guide
projects.description: An immersive entertainment discovery app featuring rich metadata like genres, alternative titles, synopses, and production houses. Powered by GetX state management with integrated TMDB community reviews and inline YouTube trailer streaming.

projects.title: MediaMeld: Wallpaper App
projects.description: A curated digital gallery of high-resolution device artwork categorized for home and lock screens. Uses GetX for reactive state management, featuring seamless offline caching and quick one-tap setup.

projects.title: B-Mark : Bookmark any Link
projects.description: A universal digital locker capturing web articles, threads, and products straight from native Android share sheets. Built with clean, lightweight vanilla state handling and Sqflite for ultra-fast local database queries.

projects.title: Sangeet
projects.description: A lightweight, elegant local music player designed for seamless playback of device-stored audio, structured efficiently with GetX reactive controllers, real-time searching, and album/artist categorization.

projects.title: Futsal Dai: Futsal Management App
projects.description: An operational mobile solution built for instant turf booking, schedule conflict resolution, and local team coordination backed by robust cloud database structures.

description: Architected and deployed 15+ production-ready cross-platform mobile applications to both Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

Engineered high-profile enterprise and civic mobile solutions for major global entities, including official Japanese government applications (Senpoke, Sendai, Fujisawa, Morinfo) and scalable enterprise systems for NTT DATA and Yonefu International Group.
Collaborated closely with cross-functional project managers and coordinators to translate complex functional requirements into stable, performant mobile features.
Integrated complex third-party SDKs including Agora for real-time media streaming and Firebase for messaging, alongside rigorous local debugging and widget optimization.
Began cross-platform mobile engineering with Flutter and Dart, building core application interfaces and state-managed components.
Coordinated with internal teams to establish compatibility with third-party software products and ensure responsive UI layouts.
Handled continuous application maintenance, rigorous debugging, and performance testing across initial client projects.
Developed scalable enterprise web applications leveraging the Yii framework and PHP backend services.
Built responsive, interactive frontend dashboards and administrative interfaces using JavaScript and ExtJS framework integration.
Designed, optimized, and maintained relational PostgreSQL database schemas to support high-throughput data processing.
Conducted exhaustive unit testing, troubleshooting, and rapid bug resolution across internal web platforms.
